title: Chapter 745 - 745 Heavenly General; Lil Stone!
content:
Chapter 745 - 745 Heavenly General; Lil Stone!

Chapter 745 - 745 Heavenly General; Lil Stone!

745 Heavenly General; Lil Stone!

On this day…

Outside the 33 heavens, the sky collapsed and the earth cracked. The sun and moon lost their light as if the end of the world had arrived. It was terrifying beyond compare.

Later on, it attracted the attention of many Holy Lords.

Tai Ba and Pu Guo were worried that others would benefit from it, so they were forced to stop fighting.

All that was left was the broken 33 Heavens and the howling of the strong winds.

And this…It was just the beginning.

Following that, a great battle broke out between the Buddha Realm and the Demon Realm. Blood flowed everywhere and it was extremely miserable.

….

Lin Fan had no idea about all of this at the moment.

However, a clear voice sounded in his mind.

[Ding! [Your enemy Tai Ba has been cursed by you and has a heart demon.]]

When Lin Fan heard that, his eyes lit up,””Finally, a heart demon has appeared. Holy Master is truly tenacious.”

After saying that, he slowly closed his eyes again.

….

On the other hand, in the dark universe.

After more than a hundred years of cultivation and fighting, Lin Chengzhen and Li Hao had grown extremely tall. Their bodies were covered with crisscrossing scars, making them look ferocious, terrifying, and powerful.

As the two of them walked on the street, greetings kept ringing out around them.

“Hello, General Lin Tian.”

“Greetings, Heavenly General Li.”

The dark universe was already extremely chaotic. In the recent hundred years, it had been affected by the news of the ocean universe, becoming even more chaotic. Wars broke out almost every day.

Lin Cheng Zhen and Li Hao chose to join a force called Dark Court.

They had fought for the Dark Court and had a great reputation in the Dark Court.

They passed through many streets and returned to their own General Duo Residence.

“Cheng Zhen, how does it feel to be a heavenly general?” Li Hao asked.”

“It’s alright,” Lin Chengzhen said.

“What do you mean by alright? That’s great!” Li Hao said excitedly,” Say, if we return to Earth now, do you think we can be compared to those gods and devils in myths and legends?”

He seemed to have already imagined the scene of earthlings prostrating, worshipping, and praising him. His face was filled with anticipation.

“Tell me, how strong is my dad?” Lin Chengzhen asked.”

Li Hao’s face stiffened when he heard this.

That’s right.

How strong?

He did not know either!

Every once in a while, Lin Fan would use his soul to communicate with Lin Cheng Zhen and impart his cultivation techniques to him.

This was also the main reason why Lin Cheng Zhen and Li Hao were able to advance their cultivation by leaps and bounds in just a hundred years and establish great achievements in the Dark Court.

There were super strong beings like Lin Fan hiding on Earth. How many more were there?

If he returned to Earth, could he really be compared to the existences in the myths and legends?

“Whoosh!”

At this moment, a black fog appeared below.

Gradually, it condensed into a short figure.

He knelt on one knee and said,” Greetings, Heavenly General Lin and Heavenly General Li. The Sovereign Lord has invited the two of you to the main hall. He has something to discuss.””

“Alright, we’ll go over now.” Lin Chengzhen said.

….

Twenty years passed in a flash.

For the past 20 years, Lin Fan had been in a state of cultivation.

The rewards of cultivating hard were also very good.

His cultivation level had already reached level 5 of the Imperial level. He was not too far away from level 6.

And in these 20 years, Lin Fan had obtained 8 Immortal Crystals, 3 Saint Crystals, 3 Emperor grade equipment and 1 Holy Lord grade treasure, Provincial Grade Gem from the system…

All of this was increasing Lin Fan’s strength.

Lin Fan was quite satisfied with this.

If he was satisfied, then he should celebrate.

Hence, Lin Fan chose to curse Bo Han 10 times.

“Dong dong dong!”

At this moment, there was a knock on the door.

Lin Fan raised his head and realized that it was Little Rock.

Lin Fan’s feelings for Little Rock were relatively special.

Even though Little Rock wasn’t born by himself, he was a life form that was born from the Holy Stone he obtained from the system and he called Lin Fan his master.

However, Lin Fan had never treated him as a servant. He had treated him as his own child.

However, this child seemed to be a little afraid of him and had never taken the initiative to look for him.

Today was a little special.

” Come in,” Lin Fan said.

As soon as he finished speaking, the door opened automatically.

Little Rock slowly walked in with a perturbed heart.

“Greetings, Master.” Little Rock said nervously.

Lin Fan nodded,” What is it?”

“Ever since master used his great power to change the spiritual energy on earth, there have been more and more cultivators on earth. Gradually, some talented ones have appeared. After learning of their master’s fame, these people gathered outside the Coiling Dragon Villa. It would be a waste to just let them wait. He wondered if his master had any thoughts of taking them in and teaching them.”Little Rock said carefully.

Lin Fan looked at him as he tried his best to act like he was knowledgeable and polite. He couldn’t help but want to laugh.

However, in order to maintain the image of the master, he held it back.

“Yes!”

“From today onwards, you can freely enter and leave the Coiling Dragon Villa. You can choose those you think are talented to train, and you can bring no more than 20 of them to the Coiling Dragon Villa.”

“Thank you, Master!” Little Rock said excitedly.”

” There are so many talented people around the mansion. I don’t think I can handle them alone. Can I bring Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann?””

He became even more cautious.

Clearly, he was worried that Lin Fan would reject him or even scold him.

“Sure,” Lin Fan said.

“Thank you, Master. Master has been invincible in the world for thousands of years!”Little Rock said excitedly.

When Lin Fan heard this, his lips twitched.

Little Rock slowly retreated.

As soon as he left, he immediately straightened his back.

Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann rushed over.

“Big brother, what did master say?”

“Did Master agree?”

“Big brother…”

Little Rock felt very comfortable calling him big brother.

He raised his head and said,”What do you think?””

The three of them opened their mouths, their eyes filled with anticipation.

“Master has already agreed. We can go out and teach some talented people.””

“Really?”

“That’s great!”

“Haha!”

The three of them shouted happily.

All these years, they had been cultivating hard, and their cultivation had improved greatly. Now, they were all star level warriors.

They enjoyed the feeling of constantly increasing their strength.

However, after a hundred years of bitter cultivation, they also felt a sense of dullness.

They hoped to go out for a walk, but they never dared to ask.

Now that he finally had this opportunity, how could he not be happy?

“Of course!” Little Rock said proudly.”

Then, he took the lead and walked out.

Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann followed behind him.

….

When Lin Fan saw this scene, he couldn’t help but laugh out loud.

“I didn’t realize that Little Rock had such a funny side.”

“Wouldn’t it be fun if the array formation around the Coiling Dragon Villa is tightly sealed later?”
